name: amp
description: Read-only access to the Amp External API (threads, usage, members, projects, repository search/contents/diffs, groups, entitlements).

AMP_CLIENT_ID.title: Amp M2M client ID
AMP_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of the Amp machine-to-machine External API Application.

AMP_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Amp M2M client secret (secret)
AMP_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of the Amp M2M application. Exchanged via OAuth2 client_credentials at https://auth.ampcode.com/oauth2/token. Set in Plugins -> Configure; never commit.

AMP_API_BASE_URL.title: Amp API base URL (optional)
AMP_API_BASE_URL.description: Override for workspaces with a required custom domain, e.g. https://your-workspace.ampcode.app/api/v2. Defaults to https://ampcode.com/api/v2.
